'''Tractor Beam 12''' was a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] control unit onboard the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. It was located in zone [[N6]], as part of the [[Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor]] within the [[Tractor beam power-generator trench]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], during the skirmish on the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], it was turned off by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to deactivate the entire tractor grid, allowing the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to escape. The system screen inscription read Power, Inoperative, and Tractor Beam 12 (Sec. N6) in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].

==Behind the scenes==
In both the original version and special edition of ''A New Hope'', the text on the tractor beam read in English and Aurebesh, respectively.
